correctness.rationale: The proof establishes C4-freeness, a natural cover with point intersections, graph connectivity, exact integral cycle kernel and source-swap sign. The complement filtration proves the eigenvalue (-1)^j on S^(2k-j,j); Pieri branching and an exact sequence prove the complete rational decomposition. The mixed character is counted from fixed oriented cells. A standalone independent character method reproduces all cycle types for k=2..5 (7+15+30+56 classes); finite checks corroborate but do not prove the unrestricted result.

originality.rationale: The novel target is the complete explicit three-row Specht decomposition together with alternating source-swap parity and mixed-cycle character for k≥3. The exact graph Hom homotopy reduction, its integral graph-cycle interpretation, and k=2 S5 specialization are acknowledged prior work. Accessible full primary homotopy papers and indexed comparisons do not state the exact additional representation theorem. Implicit deductions from their reduction and classical representation rules remain a residual originality risk.
residual_risks: General square-free graph-cover equivalence and classical Young branching might have been combined elsewhere into an equivalent representation theorem.
Abstract-only papers have not been used as proof of noncoverage.
Complete global novelty and independent validation are not established.
